parameters.name: BandwidthPackageId
parameters.description: The instance ID of the Internet Shared Bandwidth instance.

parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters.

> If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the **RequestId** of the API request as the **ClientToken**. The **RequestId** may be different for each API request.

parameters.name: IpInstanceIds
parameters.description:
The list of EIP instance IDs to be added.

You can add up to 10 EIP instance IDs at a time.

parameters.name: IpType
parameters.description: The IP type. Set the value to **EIP**, which specifies that EIPs are added to the Internet Shared Bandwidth instance.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region ID of the Internet Shared Bandwidth instance. 

You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~448570~~) operation to query the most recent region list.
